lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Hey,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: you don't have anything going on, right?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I need you to do something for me.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Nothing major.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I just need you to capture a spy and bring them back for me.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: The only problem is they're up on the surface.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Some idiot created a blog on our portal site:

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: blog.arkpia.com/raptilian

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text:
In seeing Squid, Crawler, and Sinister, an entirely new ecosystem unfolded before my very eyes. Perhaps the notion that only humans deserve to live on this planet is an arrogant one. We've always entertained the idea of coexistence... 

Source: Now, it's time to embrace a new ecosystem. 
Author: Raptilion

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: She makes it sound like she can speak with the Raptures directly.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: It's absurd.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Who wouldn't be pissed off after reading such drivel?
You should respect freedom of speech.
It's just words on the internet.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Freedom of speech?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: In the Ark?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Ha!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Get your head out of the clouds and listen up.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Fair enough.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: That's what I thought at first as well.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: However, one of the senior military officers caught wind of this

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: and contacted me.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: He was even screaming at the top of his lungs,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: demanding to know why the censorship has become so lax

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ever since they handed over the IT monopoly to Missilis.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And that, as they say,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: is that.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: If I don't find whoever wrote this blog and deliver their head on a silver platter,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: they'll really let me have it.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: In light of this, I'm sure you'll be willing to cooperate?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: If you refuse to assist in capturing a spy,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: you might as well be a spy yourself.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Catch my drift?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Now, get to it.
